test_title: PYST 4: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held On:13 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 are written on different faces of a dice. Three different positions of the same dice are shown below. Find the number on the face opposite to the one showing ‘2’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8b5a15ea7c378c6ffd6a99403a6e1765cb097c95824f9abcae8f6f0bc58f3e50.png]
solution: For find the opposite surface of '2', we need to compare the common surface in the given dices, Now, surface '2' is common in all the Dice, but from Dice 1 and Dice 3, only the surface '2' is common, so the surface which is not showing in those dice will opposite of surface '2'.
